metadata.title: Building Fintech Apps with Base44 and MoneyGraph
metadata.description: How to use Base44 AI app generator with MoneyGraph SDK. Build complete payment applications from natural language prompts.
metadata.author: MoneyGraph Team

seo.og_title: Base44 + MoneyGraph: Generate Payment Apps with AI
seo.og_description: Use Base44 to generate complete fintech applications. Our integration guide teaches Base44 to build KYC flows, FX quotes, and payouts.

content.intro: Base44 is an AI-powered app generator that creates full-stack applications from natural language descriptions. Combined with MoneyGraph SDK, you can generate complete fintech applications in minutes.

prompt_templates.name: Remittance App
prompt_templates.prompt:
Build a remittance app using MoneyGraph SDK that allows users to:
1. Register and complete KYC verification
2. Get FX quotes for USD to NGN transfers
3. Send money to Nigerian bank accounts
4. Track payout status

Use mg.customers for registration, mg.customers.kyc for verification, mg.fx for quotes, and mg.executeSmartPayout() for transfers.

prompt_templates.name: Multi-Currency Wallet
prompt_templates.prompt:
Build a wallet app using MoneyGraph SDK with:
1. User registration with KYC
2. Multi-currency wallets (USD, EUR, NGN)
3. Wallet-to-wallet transfers
4. FX conversion between currencies

prompt_templates.name: Virtual Card Platform
prompt_templates.prompt:
Build a virtual card platform using MoneyGraph SDK:
1. User registration and KYC
2. Issue virtual USD cards
3. Fund cards from wallet
4. View card transactions

patterns_followed: KYC Before Payouts - Always generates KYC checks
Quote Expiry Handling - Includes countdown timers
Error Handling - Uses MoneyGraph error types
Loading States - All API calls include indicators

tips.example: Build a send money form with amount input, currency selector, recipient bank dropdown, real-time FX quote display, 2-minute countdown timer
Handle KYC_PENDING with 'Please complete verification', QUOTE_EXPIRED with 'Rate expired, fetching new quote...'
